test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

RENOWNED
solution:
The correct answer is **'Obscure'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Renowned means **famous **or **well known**
 
• Obscure means **not discovered **or known about. it's exactly the opposite of renowned.
 
 
• Example: *Rakesh was an **obscure **__writer until a big publisher read his novel.*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• **Vain:** having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth.
 
• **Noted:** notice or pay particular attention to (something).
 
• **Glorious:** having, worthy of, or bringing fame or admiration.
